student_learning_goal: I can make a simple map of a familiar place.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make a simple map of a familiar place.
header.character_watermark: Flippy with a map in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the map. Identify 4 objects.

image_placeholders.description: A pre-built bedroom map for Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art, ~5in × 4in. Top-down view: bed (rectangle), desk (square), door (rectangle on wall), window (long rectangle). Below: 4 question lines for identifying objects.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_MAP at Part 1: keywords name the activity.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a top-down map of your bedroom. Use symbols.
parts.visual_layout: Blank map workspace ~5in × 4in with title line above.

image_placeholders.description: A blank map workspace for Grade 2 worksheet, ~5in × 4in with thin border. Above: 'My Bedroom' title line. Designed for top-down drawing with symbols.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_BLANK at Part 2: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any valid top-down bedroom map with symbols and labels.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a place at home (kitchen, yard). Map it. Add labels.
parts.visual_layout: Larger blank space with title line.

image_placeholders.description: A larger blank map workspace for Grade 2 worksheet, ~6in × 5in with thin border. Above: 'My Place: ___' title line. Designed for child's choice.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_BLANK at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any valid map with at least 3 labels.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, add a compass rose (N/S/E/W).
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Use Part 2 as formative — top-down view (not side view). Part 1 uses a NEW context (kitchen or library top-down) instead of the bedroom rehearsed in the lesson — verifies map-reading transfer.
